notes.title: 🎉 Perv's Hotel - Major Content Update Now Live! 🎉
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We’re excited to announce that Perv’s Hotel has just received a brand new update packed with fresh content and scenes! This latest release brings major new events and interactions with all the girls — but especially Evelina, Gertrud, and Alex, who have each received significant expansions to their storylines.

Whether you're continuing your journey or just getting started, now is the perfect time to dive in.

💥 To celebrate this big update, the game is now 25% OFF for a limited time!
Don’t miss your chance to experience the new content and save while you do!

Thank you all for your support, and stay tuned — more surprises are coming soon!

❤️ The Perv’s Hotel Team
